summary: CP4.25 Toplu Atama frontend testing on ATAMA MATRİSİ tab. All 7 scenarios pass: header select-all checkbox, per-row checkboxes, bulk-assign-bar (with count + manager dropdown + TOPLU ATA + × clear), sequential POST with add/skip toast, idempotent skip, clear behavior, select-all toggle, and per-row (matrix-add-*) regression flows.
action_items: Optional: consider auto-dismissing the SÜRESİ GEÇMİŞ GÖREV modal or exposing a data-testid on its close button to make regression tests less brittle (unrelated to CP4.25).
Cleanup: 2 manager_visibility rows (mgr_test → ahmet, mgr_test → emp1_test) left over from testing; harmless but can be revoked via UI × on each badge if desired.
critical_code_review_comments: bulkGrant is sequential (good for audit + rate limit); already filters out self-assignment (mgr==emp) and shows meaningful toast.
matrix-select-all uses `filteredEmployees.every` for checked state — correctly reflects filter view.
Selection state cleared after successful bulk apply but bulkMgrId preserved — good UX for repeated bulk ops.
UserManagement.jsx is 1344 lines — should be considered for splitting (Matrix view could be its own component).
No data-testid on the per-badge revoke × inside matrix (only on the badge itself). Adding matrix-revoke-{emp}-{mgr} would improve testability.
seed_data_creation: 2 manager-visibility rows created (mgr_test→ahmet, mgr_test→emp1_test). emp1_test→mgr_test already existed pre-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reach the ATAMA MATRİSİ tab: login admin → HUD [data-testid=open-settings] → [data-testid=settings-tab-users] → [data-testid=user-view-toggle-matrix]. Overdue tasks modal may appear on first load blocking clicks — close via top-right × (evaluate-based click by rect works). Verified testids: matrix-select-all, matrix-select-{username}, bulk-assign-bar, bulk-assign-manager, bulk-assign-apply, bulk-assign-clear, matrix-badge-{emp}-{mgr}, matrix-add-{username}.
